about.title: Foster City Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing someone to a preventable crash changes everything, and Foster City families are left navigating grief alongside unfamiliar legal terrain. San Mateo County recorded 2 traffic deaths and 139 injuries from collisions in the most recent final crash year, with Tuesday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. showing up often in the data along corridors like SR-92, Foster City Boulevard, and E Hillsdale Boulevard. California law gives certain survivors, starting with spouses, domestic partners, and children, the right to bring a wrongful death claim separate from any criminal proceeding against the at-fault driver. That claim can account for funeral and burial expenses, the financial support a loved one would have provided, and the loss of their companionship and guidance. LawProactive doesn't practice law; we simply help Foster City families find an independent attorney who can explain standing rules, the filing deadline, and what a claim might involve, at no upfront cost.
